+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+import os
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+from shutil import which
+
+from ._compat import get_best_encoding
+from ._compat import open_stream
+from ._compat import strip_ansi
+
+
+def explicit_color_pager(
+    generator: cabc.Iterable[str], cmd_parts: list[str], color: bool | None
+) -> bool:
+    """Page through text by invoking a program on a temporary file.
+
+    Unlike the default temporary file pager, ANSI sequences are only
+    stripped if ``color`` is explicitly ``False``. If ``color`` is
+    ``None``, the unspecified color policy is preserved and the text is
+    passed to the pager unchanged.
+
+    Returns `True` if the command was found, `False` otherwise and thus another
+    pager should be attempted.
+    """
+    # Split the command into the invoked CLI and its parameters.
+    if not cmd_parts:
+        return False
+    cmd = cmd_parts[0]
+
+    cmd_filepath = which(cmd)
+    if not cmd_filepath:
+        return False
+    # Resolves symlinks and produces a normalized absolute path string.
+    cmd_path = Path(cmd_filepath).resolve()
+
+    import subprocess
+    import tempfile
+
+    fd, filename = tempfile.mkstemp()
+    # TODO: This never terminates if the passed generator never terminates.
+    text = "".join(generator)
+    if color is False:
+        text = strip_ansi(text)
+    encoding = get_best_encoding(sys.stdout)
+    with open_stream(filename, "wb")[0] as f:
+        f.write(text.encode(encoding))
+    try:
+        subprocess.call([str(cmd_path), filename])
+    except OSError:
+        # Command not found
+        pass
+    finally:
+        os.close(fd)
+        os.unlink(filename)
+
+    return True

+import shutil
+
+import pytest
+
+from click.explicit_color_pager import explicit_color_pager
+
+needs_cat = pytest.mark.skipif(shutil.which("cat") is None, reason="requires cat")
+
+
+@needs_cat
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("color", "expected"),
+    [
+        (None, "\x1b[31mred\x1b[0m\n"),
+        (True, "\x1b[31mred\x1b[0m\n"),
+        (False, "red\n"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_strips_only_when_color_is_false(capfd, color, expected):
+    assert explicit_color_pager(["\x1b[31mred", "\x1b[0m\n"], ["cat"], color)
+    assert capfd.readouterr().out == expected
+
+
+@needs_cat
+def test_empty_input(capfd):
+    assert explicit_color_pager([], ["cat"], None)
+    assert capfd.readouterr().out == ""
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cmd_parts", [[], ["click-test-missing-pager-cmd"]])
+def test_missing_command(cmd_parts):
+    assert explicit_color_pager(["text"], cmd_parts, None) is False
+
+
+def test_os_error_is_ignored(monkeypatch):
+    import subprocess
+
+    def fail(*args, **kwargs):
+        raise OSError
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(shutil, "which", lambda cmd: "/bin/sh")
+    monkeypatch.setattr("click.explicit_color_pager.which", lambda cmd: "/bin/sh")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(subprocess, "call", fail)
+    assert explicit_color_pager(["text"], ["sh"], None) is True
